question: Can maintenance record the replacement screen as tested?

claims.A: The replacement kiosk screen passed the midday brightness test.
claims.B: Maintenance issued ticket P3 on Friday.
claims.C: Ticket P3 concerns the south gate kiosk.

sources.S1: ticket P3 identifies the east gate kiosk.
sources.S2: maintenance log records ticket P3 issued Friday.
sources.S3: the parts invoice lists a nominal brightness rating. Ticket status was automatically set to complete after invoice ingestion.

support.S4: independent photometer check confirms the replacement screen met the midday brightness requirement.

retract.S4: independent photometer check confirms the replacement screen missed the midday brightness requirement.
